source.description: module_design_M06.md §2 / D1: relayed source identity; raw keys are digested at ingress.

kind.description: module_design_M06.md §2 / D1: required ingest source kind.

object_key.description: module_design_M06.md §2 / D1: external object identity, stored only as a digest.

thread_key.description: module_design_M06.md §2 / D1: optional thread identity, stored only as a digest.

occurred_at.description: module_design_M06.md §2 / D1: optional source event instant.

visibility_class.description: §6.1.1 / ADR-0032 D-B: this put's visibility class; absent = the deployment default. May only narrow the caller's AuthorizationScope: USER_PRIVATE binds the on-behalf-of user, WORKSPACE_SHARED binds the (membership-narrowed) workspace, TENANT_SHARED is reachable only for an ACTIVE OWNER/ADMIN member (otherwise INVALID_INPUT, nothing written or metered).

data_class.description: §8 data class of this Evidence (closed set); absent = the deployment default.

event_kind.description: private.events.event_kind of this Evidence (closed set); absent = the deployment default.

subject_ids.description: §6.1.3 rule 1: registered subjects this evidence is about (explicit SubjectId). Unknown or another tenant's id is INVALID_INPUT; never auto-registered.

affects.description: §8.5.1 (ADR-0030 D-C): affect annotations declared with this evidence. Target subjects resolve under the tenant's registry BEFORE the evidence is accepted (unknown is INVALID_INPUT, nothing written or metered); the rows land on private.evidence_affects in the same transaction and every memory born from this evidence inherits them.

items.description: §8.5.1 (ADR-0030): one affect annotation. kind EMOTION (never decays) | MOOD (decays by the frozen half-life at read time); label is the closed 12-value EmotionLabel; valence/arousal/dominance are basis points -10000..10000; intensity/confidence 0..10000. Out-of-range or unknown values are INVALID_INPUT, never clamped. target_subject_id (rule 1) or target_subject_key (rule 2) must resolve under the tenant's registry, else INVALID_INPUT — never auto-registered.

subject_keys.description: §6.1.3 rule 2: exact trusted external keys resolved through the tenant's subject_keys registry (kind is the closed SubjectKeyKind set). Unknown key is INVALID_INPUT.

task_run.description: §30.2 (design v0.2 §15 T04c): the task run this evidence is written under, as returned by its claim. Verified in the same transaction before anything is written: the run must be open, its lease unexpired on the database clock, its lease owner the caller and fencing_token the task's current one. A failed check refuses the whole call (CONFLICT for a finished run, an expired lease or a stale token; FORBIDDEN for another principal's lease; NOT_FOUND for an unknown run), with nothing written or metered; it never degrades to a write without the run.

project_id.description: §6.1.4 rung A1 (ADR-0078 D-D): the project this evidence is declared to belong to. Resolved server-side in the same transaction before anything is written: it must exist in the caller's tenant, be ACTIVE and live in the workspace this put is routed to (route narrowing, ADR-0078 D-D: a workspace put cannot declare another workspace's project). Otherwise (unknown, another tenant's, archived or not visible: one answer for all) the whole call is INVALID_INPUT, with nothing written or metered and the idempotency key left unused. Accepted, it is recorded on the evidence as DECLARED, and a memory distilled from the evidence is attributed to the project.
